cohort: A total of 89 pregnant subjects from Nagoya University Hospital, including those with normal pregnancies at various stages and those with a range of maternal and fetal disorders, from whom amniotic fluid samples were collected.
finding: Catalytic Fe(II) levels were higher in the 2nd trimester than the 3rd trimester in normal subjects and generally higher in abnormal groups, suggesting its potential as a marker for fetal pathologic alterations, while 8-OHdG and dityrosine showed opposite trends related to fetal metabolic activities.
